name: Elise Dubois
bio:
Elise Dubois is a seasoned finance controller with a decade of experience in high-pressure environments. Born and raised in Geneva, she developed a passion for motorsport through her father, a former rally co-driver. After graduating with a degree in Economics from the University of St. Gallen, she initially worked in traditional banking before realizing her true calling lay in combining her financial expertise with her love for racing.

Elise joined Reiza Studios Factory three years ago, bringing a meticulous and innovative approach to managing the team's finances. She is known for her ability to identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising performance, and for her proactive approach to financial planning. Her creative solutions to budgetary challenges have earned her the respect of her colleagues and the admiration of the team principal. Elise's dedication to accuracy and her drive for perfection make her an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Elise has a focused gaze and an elegant, professional demeanor.

quirks: Always has a meticulously organized spreadsheet for every possible scenario.
Drinks herbal tea exclusively during race weekends.
